reserveReview.rationale: The official dashboard API snapshot lastUpdated 2026-10-10T23:31:24Z, accessed 2026-10-10T23:32:14Z, reports $3,551,106.7985090325 of cross-chain USDC, $1,616,576.9469646285 of cross-chain USDT, $10,928.534863734498 of Sonic USSD, $123.87360449585377 of Ethereum USDe and $21,964.87694068347 of Ethereum crvUSD. The complete nine collateral rows across Ethereum, Sonic and BNB Smart Chain sum to $5,200,701.030882575; percentages use those unrounded token TVLs, not display-rounded sharePct or ftUSD supply. The previously zero crvUSD position is now positive and retains its reviewed exact underlying identity. USDG is an explicitly observed zero row. FDUSD is absent from this snapshot and is removed rather than represented as an observed zero. These categories describe collateral wrapper claims, not debt-netted strategy assets, independent financial assurance, or guaranteed withdrawal liquidity.
